scope: Integrate the strict checked artifact DAG into canonical proof publication and finalized-history authoring
implementation: ArtifactDag and authenticated artifact set move from chain to ledger. ProofLibrary owns that DAG; normalized packages stage and atomically install DAG plus matching publication provenance.

Crate-private metered checked-proof admission compares expected ID before strict registration. External byte admission remains decode, canonical validation, mathematical check, expected-ID comparison, atomic registration. No added checker calls.
The DAG set is derived exactly from the already committed library records. Library, state, consensus, record and SMT wire encodings and golden vectors are unchanged.
Authoring accepts only the sealed full-history interface for selected dependencies and rejects halted history before source parsing. The ArtifactChainJournal authoring adapter is removed.

Offline explicit checked contexts preserve conservative definitions, exact citations, function sugar and large standalone mathematical proofs without changing proof-only MVP publication or package limits.

replacement_coverage.dag: Existing SMT codec, mutation corpus, roots, membership, nonmembership, insertion-order and structural-sharing tests relocated. Existing strict DAG tests relocated; metered expected-ID failure preserves empty resolver/set.
replacement_coverage.publication: Independent strict DAG reconstruction from published canonical certificates matches records, dependencies, set witnesses and root. Normalization remains read-only; successful publication installs both, repeat publication leaves both unchanged; metered B citation uses the same four checker calls.
replacement_coverage.authoring_mathematics: All six original mathematical scenario families and three MVP fixture families preserved with 25 golden IDs, NAO0016 source span, exact dependencies and byte sizes. The 110196-byte empty-set proof remains offline, above the unchanged MVP 64KiB cap.
replacement_coverage.selected_history: Actual canonical signed submit/vote/commit/reveal/settlement sequence: checked or certified unselected helper cannot resolve; selected helper can. Output remains unpublished, metadata/history/anchor bytes unchanged; cold reopen and read-only observer agree. Conflict halt precedes valid or malformed source.
